reviews.text:
I have been going to Terenure Veterinary for over 20 years. Very pleased with the treatments given. All our pets have been well looked after in a compassionate manner. Their fees are reasonable.
Mark and his team are exceptional. Highly recommend.

I would not recommend South Dublin Vets. While they are quick to take full payment and charge high fees at the time of treatment, they have proven extremely slow at processing and submitting pet insurance claim forms across both of their branches. My family, along with several other pet owners we know, have been left waiting weeks for them to send off basic paperwork. It is frustrating to pay up front only to deal with continuous administrative delays on their end, so we will be moving our pets to another veterinary practice that actually handles claims promptly

I am Moving vets away from this one , happy to take money from pet owners but failing to submit pet claims????
Not happy
Nice and helpful staff , recommended
Mark and all the Team did a wonderful  job looking  after my little  dog  Harry over  the past  few years.  Would highly  recommend  them!
Best care for dogs anywhere. All of the staff are kind, compassionate and go beyond the call of duty. I would never take my dogs anywhere else.
Brilliant Vets. Its hard when you have a sick pet but they are all Brilliant and put you at ease and the pet care is exceptional

Mark and the team did an amazing job with my dog. We had been going to two vets over a two year period with an ongoing issue that was just getting worse. After a few visits with Mark, my dog is fit and healthy again and we are so happy to find such a good vet. Thank you
They are nice people there & Mark is very good with my dog Rolo, unfortunately I don’t have photos of terenure veterinary hospital only my dog Rolo.

Everything went very well. I was a bit worried because my English is not very strong, but it did not cause any problems at all. The doctor was very understanding and, with the help of a translator, explained everything clearly and described the treatment plan in detail. I’m very grateful for the attentive and professional care.
Brilliant vets. So kind, very thorough.
Professional service from start to finish.
The team here are very friendly, both the vets and reception staff. My cat was absolutely relaxed while being examined by a fellow cat owner.

We are incredibly grateful to Mark and his team at Terenure Veterinary Hospital. His medical knowledge and compassionate care are second to none. He saved our cat’s life and went above and beyond to extend her lifespan.
I trust his judgement completely. He explains options without pressure and answers every question patiently.
Our cats are safe in his hands, and the peace of mind that brings is priceless.
Excellent practice great attention to detail and more importantly kind when dealing with the animals. Care abd attention all round.

Mark and the staff are excellent and really care for their clients. Duke doesn't mind going to see the vet which is a plus (except for getting his temperature taken, but hey I can understand that 😊)
Would have no problem with recommending Terenure Veterinary.
Since my initial posting Duke has sadly crossed Rainbow Bridge. We now have Sadie, a rescue who is also a patient here.
So far she likes her visits here,(probably helped by Shane's treat stash), she has yet to have her temperature taken😜
Great vets, they have given our dogs the best care possible.

I had an excellent experience at Terenure Veterinary Hospital. The team was incredibly kind, professional, and attentive throughout our visit. They treated my pet, Óisín, with genuine care and compassion, and took the time to explain everything clearly and calmly. It’s obvious they truly care about animals and their owners. I couldn’t recommend them highly enough — a well-deserved 5 stars.

Have used this practice for many years now and find them absolutely fantastic. Always take very good care, and are kind to both owners and animals. Have brought all our dogs there from puppies and throughout their lives, and when it came to end of life, they couldn’t have tried harder or been more empathetic. Will never go anywhere else!
Amazing veterinary clinic with such lovely and dedicated staff.

What a wonderful experience from the smiley faces at the reception to the wonderful vet who was looking after mums dog. Very professional and you just know that the pets are getting the best care from the staff and are animal lovers it is not just a job to them it is a vocation.  Thank you so much.
Affordable price and friendly staff.

I brought a kitten to this vets many years ago I was staying the night locally & when I woke up the kitten was floppy I drove her to the nearest Vet I had no cash on me I was panicking the Vet tall man & the girl nurse was amazing they said it’s ok Softpaws didn’t make it no fault to the Vet. So the following day I dropped an envelope in there letterbox with cash tall Vet John might have been his name  phoned me to say it was way to much I said yous helped me & did everything they could for Softpaws. So during the call I told him another kitten a feisty and chatty kitten came to my home I brought her to my local Vets in a different county she wasn’t to good  either. Whinjer we called her because she never stops talking she hitting 19 years old now.

Honestly this is the only vet clinic our dog Sugar has EVER willingly walked into. Mark is just a super human with an incredible knack for understanding our dogs needs. She is 15 and he makes sure she gets the treatment she needs and deserves each time she visits. We really feel like he knows her and gives her the space and time to settle in when she's in his room. Its just so reassuring to know she is in the hands of someone who not only his stuff but also cares. Couldn't recommend the place more.
Excellent vets who support the Cat and Dog Protection Association and helps our strays and foster animals get better
Extremely professional Vets, very nice and kind. Highly recommend.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 5/5 – Amazing Team, Great Care for Hazel (Titi)

Today I brought my cat Hazel (Titi) in for her sterilisation surgery, and I couldn’t be more impressed with the care and professionalism of the entire team. From the moment we arrived, everyone was warm, reassuring, and truly compassionate — not just toward Titi, but toward me as well.

They explained everything clearly, made sure I felt comfortable, and treated Hazel with incredible gentleness. The surgery went very well, and she’s already doing great at home — eating, drinking, and resting calmly.

Huge thank you to the whole team for their kindness and support. It really made this experience so much easier for both of us. I would absolutely recommend this clinic to anyone looking for trustworthy and loving care for their pets.
So lovely to deal with! They looked after our little cat Lana without hesitation and had her back home with us, bandaged up the next day.

I’ve been bringing my dog here for a while, and they’re always incredibly helpful, professional, and caring. The staff take the time to answer all my questions and really make sure my dog is comfortable. Appointments are easy to book and you can tell they genuinely care about animals. I always feel confident my dog is in good hands here. Highly recommend this vet clinic to anyone looking for reliable, compassionate care!

Worst Experience of my life with this place!! They have ZERO knowledge about dogs, gave my extremely sick pug wrong medication and diagnosed her with the wrong illness! All they worry about is the money!

Please listen to me when I say. Go down the road to village Vets Rathgar you won't pay anymore money and the experience and knowledge they have will blow you away!
Lovely staff, helpful and supportive.
Been taking my family pets here for the longest time and couldn’t ask for better service

I gave been attending with my 11 year old chocolate Labrador for about 6 months now and what I absolutely love is
1. The ease of getting an appointment
2. The time spent in a consultation, my dog is checked over thoroughly, I have an opportunity to ask questions and discuss, I am not rushed.
3. All staff are brilliant, I have mainly seen Mark and Dave for bigger issues and I trust completely that my dog is in good hands.
4. The pricing is excellent for the service I received. And nothing is too much trouble for the staff at this establishment.

I previously was with a vet for 10 years. The main issue was the quick turnaround in a consultation, leaving the premises and thinking I had forgotten to ask and discuss something. Also the trouble getting meds which they would never attempt to get for me and finally and this is not the big thing but it was not good value, more expensive for a lesser service and my dog has cost a lot and I would pay it again but it's so nice to know that my dog gets a full consultation and I leave with the knowledge and peace of mind.

Must say the staff here are top shelf. Our dog was extremely sick when I called very late in the evening. Everyone was packed up and ready to go home when we arrived with a very sick dog. The vet or the nurses didn't hesitate or look at the clock once and Dave operated on our dog within the hour. Follow up from Mark next day and she is at home now milking the attention. Also have to comment on the cost, we were given an amount, which I know from experience was fair, and was very surprised that we were charged almost 20% less. If looking for a good vet for your animals look no further.

I adopted a 17-year-old cat, and Mark and the other vets helped her have a brilliant life past 20. I always appreciated their care and consideration, and this was true up until my final visit to Dundrum a few weeks ago. I was struck by the care that I received and the gentleness that little Munchie felt on her last trip. It all meant so much on a very sad day. Thank you from both of us <3
Lovely people to deal with. My chihuahua was neutered with them and they were beyond compassionate and helpful. Highly reccommend them!!
So lovely and good team working.
Fast friendly efficient hospital, what’s not to like!!!
Excellent wouldn't go anywhere else. These guys love and care for what they do. My Daisy is well looked after TG

Very good vet and lovely lady on the desk as you walk in.. Very pleasant indeed.. and excellent with our pet Puppy..very attentive towards her lot's of time for Puppy's well being and carried out duty very professionally.  Took his time to make sure that Puppy got her treatment that she needed.. brilliant.
They treat my puppy awesomely. They have answered all my questions and he is healthy.
100 excellent. Super vets who genuinely care for our pets.

My pets are always extremely well treated at Terenure Vet Hospital. We have a cat and a dog, and Dave and Mark are the vets who usually see them, but all vets from the very beginning were great. Neutering, vaccinations and the casual sickness have always been effectively dealt with. My cat needed last minute treatment once around the time all vets nearby would close. Dave very kindly chose to stay late and help me with my cat, who got better and ready to go home on the following day. My dog has difficult behaviour and a health issue that sometimes causes him pain. Mark, who is the regular vet for our dog, is always very patient and kind when we need to have the dog seen, or when we need to discuss something on the phone to address any ongoing issues. The ladies at the reception are also brilliant and welcome my nervous dog when we pop in just to get a treat and collect medication, helping my dog to be less overwhelmed when going for consultations, scans or injections. We cannot recommend or thank them enough for all the effort and dedication, and even though there are other vet clinics closer to home, we prefer bringing them to Terenure Vet Hospital no matter what.
Amazing vet, Dave is so thorough and the staff are all so caring!
Lovely staff
Great vets great staff
Staff are always so kind and cinsiderate to animals. Always super helpful, recommend!
Vet Dave did a very thorough examination of our cat and took good care of him. He obviously has a genuine concern for his patients and knows exactly what to do.

My cats have been treated her for over 20 years now. Mark and his team are wonderful caring staff. Smokey photo is a stray with lots of problems but with the attention of Mark he is now living his best life in my bathroom
Great Vets. Wonderful service. My dog is a very happy pet patient.

Incredible vets, 5 stars! Swift care, no packed waiting room, absolutely lovely receptionist. Very efficient, compassionate and excellent value. Can't recommend them highly enough. Came to them in distress after being given a disastrous prognosis for my cocker spaniel by our regular vets. She had a lump which I was told could be cancerous and would probably require surgery for removal- the removal of which would have a debilitating effect on the dog due to the placement of the lump. So thankful for Terenure Vets compassionate approach and efficient prognosis which turned out to be 100% accurate; the lump was a harmless polyp for which no surgery was needed. I've been back with both my dogs since, they had dental surgery done and have been treated regularly with de-wormers etc. Eternally grateful for this vets, thanks to the whole team!!!
No appointment. Looked after quickly as pet unwell and had been vomiting
Nice staff, great job

My cat received the best care and treatment when he was unwell recently, so grateful and appreciative of the excellent care, kindness and support for my sweet little Orwell who is  feeling back to his wonderful self again, highly recommend this practice.
Amazing vets, kind and caring 💛 …
